description: Real airborne LiDAR datasets the terrain field-validation harness runs OLV terrain outputs against. All are public and citable. Raw clouds are NOT committed (too large); each records its DOI/source, spatial reference, and the sha256 of the source file the committed crops were cut from. `sourceId` is a handle local to this harness: it names an acquisition as the publisher distributes it (a tile, a survey, a release), and the crops under `crops/` cite it to say which bytes they were cut from. It is NOT a `datasetId` in validation/datasets/dataset-register.yaml and does not resolve there. Three of these acquisitions cannot meet that register's contract: the raw StREAM Lab, Hyytiala and Pangandaran clouds have no recorded sha256, and the Zenodo terms for the latter two were never resolved to a named licence, which the register rejects rather than records as unknown. The field was called `datasetId` until the rename, which asserted a foreign key none of these values ever had. scripts/lint-terrain-field-ids.mjs keeps the name from coming back and keeps every crop citation resolving here.

datasets.title: USGS 3DEP LPC, White Sands NM 2020, tile w3597n3635
datasets.source: USGS 3D Elevation Program (3DEP) Lidar Point Cloud
datasets.terrain: bare-earth gypsum dunes; sparse vegetation; clean ground

datasets.title: Virginia Tech StREAM Lab Spring 2026 Drone Lidar Survey
datasets.publishedProducts: 0.1 m DTM (with interpolated stream bathymetry) and 0.1 m CHM
datasets.terrain: riparian; open field + dirt road (good ground) beside dense trees + stream (poor ground)
datasets.role: high-density DTM/CHM real-reference leg; crop to open-field ground away from the stream (bathymetry is interpolated in the published DTM)

datasets.title: Hyytiälä UAV Point Cloud Demo Dataset 2025
datasets.terrain: boreal forest; dense canopy — ground under canopy is the hard case, OLV reads it as an object
datasets.role: stress case: ground extraction / DTM under dense forest canopy (source cloud is unclassified, so it validates OLV's classifier, not against one)

datasets.title: Drone LiDAR of Pangandaran coastal tourism hotspots (tsunami/climate risk)
datasets.terrain: coastal; built + vegetated tourism area — flat coastal ground plus structures
datasets.role: future leg: coastal ground + building/structure classification

datasets.title: Estonian Land Board National LiDAR, 2020 (tile 568539, Tava area)
datasets.source: Estonian Land and Spatial Development Board (Maa-amet)
datasets.horizontalCrs: L-EST97 / Estonian Coordinate System of 1997, Lambert Conformal Conic (EPSG:3301)
datasets.terrain: flat boreal plain; classified national survey; ~1.6 m of relief in the crop
datasets.role: third projection family — Lambert Conformal Conic gridding correctness leg

datasets.title: USGS Marsh Island / New Bedford MA UAS survey, 2024 (site 2025-009-FA)
datasets.citation: Over, J.R., Cramer, J.M., Millo, A., Brosnahan, S.M., Ackerman, S.D., and Ganju, N.K., 2024, Topographic, multispectral, and GPS data collected during UAS operations at Marsh Island, New Bedford, Massachusetts (ver. 2.0, May 2026), USGS data release.
datasets.sensor: Agisoft Metashape photogrammetry/LiDAR (UAS); Emlid RS3 RTK checkpoints
datasets.terrain: coastal salt marsh; bare-earth near sea level (~1.5-3.5 m NAVD88)
datasets.licence: CC0 1.0 Universal / public domain (U.S. Government work); no use constraints
datasets.role: absolute vertical accuracy vs INDEPENDENT surveyed RTK checkpoints (same NAVD88 datum as the cloud; no reconciliation)

datasets.title: USGS AZ Coconino B1 2019 airborne LiDAR (Atlantic project 19049; task order AZ_CoconinoUSFS_2019_B19)
datasets.source: U.S. Geological Survey 3D Elevation Program (3DEP) / The National Map
datasets.citation: U.S. Geological Survey, 2020, USGS Lidar Point Cloud AZ_CoconinoUSFS_2019_B19 (USGS project 19049; NGTOC task order 140G0219F0247, contract G16PC00042): U.S. Geological Survey 3D Elevation Program (3DEP). Public domain.
datasets.sensor: Optech Galaxy Prime airborne LiDAR (summer 2019, leaf-on); ground survey NVA/VVA checkpoints held separate from the 12 LiDAR Control Points
datasets.independentCheckpoints: 121 project-wide (1 inside tile w1407n1486: TR03, a vegetated/VVA checkpoint at 2567.66 m)
datasets.terrain: steep forested plateau, Coconino National Forest (~2500-2730 m NAVD88); bare-earth under canopy
datasets.licence: Public domain (U.S. Geological Survey / The National Map); no use constraints
datasets.role: absolute vertical accuracy vs INDEPENDENT surveyed VVA/NVA checkpoints (same NAVD88 datum as the cloud; no reconciliation); the forested VVA case complements the flat-marsh Marsh Island leg
